correctness.rationale: The exact Green-kernel inverse identity (1+theta^2)w_i-theta(w_{i-1}+w_{i+1})=(1-theta)^2 phi_i for w=P phi follows by direct convolution. Substituting P phi=rho D phi yields a Jacobi recurrence whose perturbation epsilon_i=(1-theta)^2/(theta rho mu_i) is absolutely summable because alpha>1. Independently checked the Volterra difference equation Delta_i=theta^2 Delta_{i+1}+theta epsilon_i z_i under w_i=theta^i z_i: backward summation has tail contraction norm <= theta/(1-theta^2) sum_{k>N}|epsilon_k|. Reduction of order produces a growing branch, excluded by w in l1. A positive decaying solution has nonzero positive amplitude; spectral simplicity and reflection give equal +/- tails. Geometric dominated convergence proves the exact two-tail mass and the boundary moment converges precisely since sum n^{-alpha} is finite. This does not estimate truncated eigenvector error and requires both symmetry and alpha>1.
